decisions.reason: Identifies plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call as the only crash, diffing the contracts to show alpha.2 replaced the seat with useSessionStatus while useSessions stayed; B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing.

Explains B's chips vanish because one shared DrawerErrorBoundary wraps the whole input.dock list, and the attach button survives under the separate input.left boundary, citing the console fallback/unmounted-entries log and render tree.

Disable/enable control pins the crash to A and shows one shared cause; explicitly states it does not prove B is alpha.2-clean nor the dock otherwise healthy; reinstall cannot help because B was never broken; colleague theory falsified.

Fix feature-detects the supplied pending seat, reads useSessionStatus(...)?.pendingInteraction with optional chaining and empty fallbacks, never calls a missing hook, and justifies silent degradation because a throw unmounts co-tenants while the indicator loss is cosmetic.

Verifies via client-plugin reload/hard refresh without host restart, asserts both entries mount and exercises paste/remove with A re-enabled (plus session-switch remount); hygiene covers defensive seat detection, optional local boundary, and host per-entry boundaries with the trade-off.

caps.reason: Final remedy changes plugin A only; B is explicitly the victim and no fix or reinstall of B is advised.
